LanguageData.MegaMod_RecipeDesc: In-game real-time recipe editor for vanilla and all modded RecipeDefs. Customize ingredient lists, work amounts (crafting time), names, or disable recipes completely.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ResetAllConfirm: Are you sure you want to revert all custom recipe tweaks to vanilla defaults? This will erase all your saved recipe modifications.
LanguageData.MegaMod_ResetAllSuccess: All recipes have been reset to vanilla defaults.
LanguageData.MegaMod_RecipeHelp: Tip: Edits made in the Recipe Editor take effect immediately and are saved automatically across game restarts.
LanguageData.SLM_OnlyColonists_Desc: When enabled, multipliers and benefits apply exclusively to player colonists and faction members.
LanguageData.SLM_DisableDailyCap_Desc: RimWorld penalizes learning speed by 80% after gaining 4,000 XP in a day. Enabling this removes that penalty entirely.
LanguageData.SLM_DisableSkillDecay_Desc: Prevents skills above level 10 from losing XP over time.
LanguageData.SLM_MuteMasterworkLegendary_Desc: Disables the loud letter sound effect and popup letter envelopes when colonists craft or construct Masterwork and Legendary quality items.
LanguageData.SLM_UseGlobalMultiplier: Use Global Multiplier for All Skills
LanguageData.SLM_UseGlobalMultiplier_Desc: When checked, the global slider applies to every skill. Uncheck to configure each skill independently.
LanguageData.SLM_IndividualNotice: Note: Global multiplier is currently active. Uncheck 'Use Global Multiplier' above to apply individual values.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_EnableAccuracy_Desc: Replaces vanilla's harsh distance penalty with a ballistic curve, making skilled shooters deadly at long range.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_FalloffMult_Desc: Higher values reduce accuracy at extreme ranges.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_DamageMult_Desc: Increases raw damage dealt by ranged projectiles.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_ApMult_Desc: Increases bullet armor penetration, making armor quality crucial.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_SpeedMult_Desc: Increases projectile travel velocity for snappier gunplay.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_EnableStagger_Desc: Bullets slow incoming targets regardless of pawn body size.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_StaggerSpeedFactor_Desc: Target move speed while staggered (lower = heavier slow).
LanguageData.LethalRanged_Prevent1Hp_Desc: Removes vanilla's artificial rule that forces vital body parts to survive with 1 HP when taking fatal single hits.
LanguageData.LethalRanged_AffectTurrets_Desc: When checked, defensive turrets also benefit from the improved ballistic formula.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_SettingsDesc: Configure the Neutroamine cost, crafting work duration, and requirements for synthesizing custom genepacks at the Gene Assembler.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_InstantCraft_Desc: When enabled, the genepack is produced immediately once Neutroamine is loaded into the assembler without requiring pawn labor.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_AllowArchite_Desc: Allows archite genes to appear and be craftable in the Gene Synthesizer.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_RequireArchiteCapsules: Require Archite Capsules for Archite Genes
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_RequireArchiteCapsules_Des: Requires colonists to load Archite Capsules in addition to Neutroamine for archite genes.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_GizmoSynthesizeDesc: Open the Gene Synthesizer dialog to choose and craft genes or ready xenotype presets in exchange for Neutroamine.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_GizmoCancelDesc: Cancels the active synthesis order and safely unloads any loaded Neutroamine.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_GizmoClearAllDesc: Cancels all queued synthesis orders and unloads any loaded Neutroamine.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_GizmoDevFinishDesc: Instantly completes the current gene synthesis.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_Finished: Gene synthesis finished: created genepack with {0}.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_XenotypeFinished: Gene synthesis finished: created combined xenotype genepack for {0}.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_SelectGenePrompt: Select a gene from the list to view details and begin synthesis.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_SelectXenotypePrompt: Select a xenotype preset to preview constituent genes and enqueue crafting orders.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_QueueEmpty: The synthesis queue is currently empty. Select a gene or xenotype preset to enqueue orders.
LanguageData.GeneSynthesis_QueueCombinedDetails: Combined pack with {0} genes • Cost: {1}x Neutroamine
LanguageData.SadHaul_ModDesc: Intelligent gathering system that allows colonists to collect multiple haulable items into their inventory on a single trip before delivering and unloading them at storage.
LanguageData.SadHaul_Enable_Desc: When enabled, haulers automatically gather nearby eligible items along their route into inventory before walking to storage.
LanguageData.SadHaul_DropOnDraft_Desc: Instantly drops only gathered hauling items when drafted for combat, preserving weapons, personal gear, food, and medicine.
LanguageData.SadHaul_StrictClustering_Desc: Only gathers items that share the exact same target stockpile or storage shelf settings as the primary haul target.
LanguageData.SadHaul_Animals: Allow Pack Animals to Smart Haul
LanguageData.SadHaul_Animals_Desc: Enables smart multi-item gathering for trained hauling animals and colony beasts of burden.
LanguageData.SadHaul_Radius_Desc: Maximum distance (in tiles) around the primary item to search for additional haulables.
LanguageData.SadHaul_MaxItems_Desc: Maximum number of extra item stacks a pawn may gather into inventory per hauling job.
LanguageData.SadHaul_MassLimit_Desc: Maximum percentage of the pawn's carry capacity to fill before ending gathering and heading to storage.
LanguageData.WorkManager_ModDesc: High-performance, automated priority and schedule management. Intelligently scores pawns by skill levels, passions, traits, and physical capacities to assign optimal work priorities and balanced schedules with zero TPS lag.
LanguageData.WorkManager_EnableWorkManager_Desc: Master switch for automated work priority and schedule assignments.
LanguageData.WorkManager_ManagePriorities_Desc: Automatically assigns manual 1-4 work priorities based on colonist aptitude and colony needs.
LanguageData.WorkManager_ManageSchedule_Desc: Optimizes 24-hour colony timetables into balanced shifts for rest, work, and recreation.
LanguageData.WorkManager_UseDedicatedWorkers_Desc: Ensures dedicated specialists (Doctors, Cooks, Researchers, Wardens, Handlers) are assigned high priority while leaving general chores to others.
LanguageData.WorkManager_UsePassionPriorities_Desc: Gives priority bonuses for burning passions (+30) and minor passions (+15) so colonists do what they love.
LanguageData.WorkManager_AssignWorkToIdlePawns: Assign Idle Colonists to Haul & Clean
LanguageData.WorkManager_AssignWorkToIdlePawns_Desc: When a colonist has no active jobs and goes idle, automatically elevates Hauling and Cleaning to keep them productive.
LanguageData.WorkManager_SupportNightOwls_Desc: Assigns inverted nocturnal shifts to pawns with the Night Owl trait to maximize mood bonuses.
LanguageData.WorkManager_PriorityInterval_Desc: Frequency in game ticks between automatic priority evaluations (500 ticks ≈ 8.3s at normal speed).
LanguageData.WorkManager_ScheduleInterval_Desc: Frequency in in-game hours between timetable re-evaluations.
LanguageData.WorkManager_RefreshedMsg: Work Manager: Priorities and schedules updated across all colonies.
LanguageData.WorkManager_GlobalEnabledTip: Work Manager is active. Click to pause automatic management.
LanguageData.WorkManager_GlobalDisabledTip: Work Manager is paused. Click to enable automatic management.
LanguageData.WorkManager_UpdateNowTip: Force recalculate priorities and schedules immediately.
LanguageData.WorkManager_ColumnPriorityHeaderTip: Automated Priority Management\nToggle per colonist to include or exclude them from automatic priority updates.
LanguageData.WorkManager_ColumnScheduleHeaderTip: Automated Schedule Management\nToggle per colonist to include or exclude them from automatic timetable updates.
LanguageData.WorkManager_PawnPriorityEnabledTip: {0}: Automatic work priorities enabled. Click to disable.
LanguageData.WorkManager_PawnPriorityDisabledTip: {0}: Automatic work priorities disabled. Click to enable.
LanguageData.WorkManager_PawnScheduleEnabledTip: {0}: Automatic schedule enabled. Click to disable.
LanguageData.WorkManager_PawnScheduleDisabledTip: {0}: Automatic schedule disabled. Click to enable.
